meta.title: Services
meta.description: Social media, performance marketing, SEO, branding, web development and influencer campaigns — delivered by one senior team.

hero.heading: Growth, engineered channel by channel

servicesIntro.heading: Six services, one accountable team
servicesIntro.subheading: Every engagement starts with the same question: what is actually stopping this business from growing right now?

services.title: Social Media Marketing
services.tagline: Build a brand people choose to follow
services.description: We run your social presence like a media company — a clear content pillar strategy, a reels-first production rhythm and community management that turns followers into buyers.
features: Paid social amplification of top organic
services.idealFor: D2C brands, personal brands and local businesses building awareness.

services.title: Performance Marketing
services.tagline: Paid media judged on profit, not clicks
services.description: Meta, Google, YouTube and LinkedIn campaigns built around unit economics. We structure accounts for clean learning, then let creative testing do the heavy lifting.
features: Account audit & tracking setup (GA4, pixels, CAPI)
Live dashboard with CAC, ROAS & LTV

services.title: SEO & Content

services.description: Technical foundations, topical authority and genuinely useful content. SEO is the channel that keeps paying after you stop spending — if it's built properly.
features: Technical audit & Core Web Vitals fixes

services.title: Branding & Design
services.tagline: Look like the leader of your category
services.description: Positioning, identity and design systems that make a young brand feel established — then campaign creative that carries it across every channel.

services.title: Web & Landing Pages
services.tagline: Sites built to convert, not just to exist
services.description: Fast, responsive, search-friendly websites and landing pages. Designed around the buying decision and wired for clean analytics from launch day.
services.idealFor: Brands whose traffic is fine but conversion isn't.

services.title: Influencer & Digital PR
services.description: Creator partnerships sourced on engagement quality, not follower vanity — plus press placements that make your brand look inevitable.
services.idealFor: Consumer brands that need social proof fast.

process.heading: From first call to first result
process.subheading: Same four steps whether you hire us for one channel or all six.

steps.title: Discovery call
steps.description: 30 minutes on your goals, numbers and constraints. You leave with at least one thing to fix, hired or not.

steps.title: Audit & proposal
steps.description: We audit your accounts and come back with a scoped plan, timeline and a fixed monthly number.

steps.title: Onboard & launch
steps.description: Access, tracking and creative in week one. First campaigns and content live inside two weeks.

steps.title: Review & scale
steps.description: Weekly iteration, monthly reviews. We scale what earns and cut what doesn't, transparently.

packages.heading: Simple, honest pricing
packages.subheading: Retainers scale with scope and ad spend. Every plan includes a named strategist and a shared channel.
packages.note: Prices exclude GST and ad spend. Custom scopes welcome — most of our clients end up with one.
packages.billingNote: Minimum 90-day initial term, then month to month.

items.question: Can we start with just one service?
items.answer: Absolutely. Most clients start with one channel — usually paid social or SEO — and add services once they trust the process. We'll tell you honestly which single channel we'd start with for your business.

items.question: Is ad spend included in the retainer?
items.answer: No. Ad spend goes directly to Meta, Google or LinkedIn from your own accounts. Our fee covers strategy, creative, management and reporting.

items.question: How much ad budget do we need to start?
items.answer: For meaningful learning we recommend a minimum of ₹1,00,000 per month in spend for performance marketing. Below that, organic and content usually give you better returns first.

items.question: Who owns the creative and accounts?
items.answer: You do — always. Ad accounts, pixels, source files, domains and content libraries stay in your name from day one.

items.question: Do you offer one-off projects?
items.answer: Yes, for branding, websites and launch campaigns. Ongoing channels like SEO and paid media only work as retainers, so we don't sell those as one-offs.

cta.heading: Not sure which service you need?
cta.subheading: That's exactly what the first call is for. Bring your numbers, we'll tell you where the biggest gap is — and what we'd fix first.
